The parallelized perspective shear-warp algorithm for volume rendering
That may be because it is slower than the parallel projection algorithm and often slower than hardware supported approaches. In this paper, we present a new parallelized version of the perspective shear-warp algorithm. The parallelized algorithm was designed for distributed memory machines using MPI.
